title: The Lost Scholar
description: Find the missing scholar lost within the Ruined Watchtower of Ashenvale.

objectives.description: Find the missing scholar beneath the watchtower.

title: The Hollowroot Trail
description: Follow the trail left by the missing scholar and uncover what is drawing creatures into Ashenvale.

objectives.description: Investigate the creatures gathering along the trail.
Recover the scholar's missing research page.

title: Secrets of Blackspire
description: Take the recovered research to Blackspire Keep and discover why the fortress is connected to the scholar's investigation.

objectives.description: Locate the sealed archive beneath the keep.

title: The Bloodglass Sanctum
description: Open the ancient sanctum and confront the secret behind the Bloodlands' awakening bloodline powers.

objectives.description: Confront the guardian of the sanctum.
Discover the truth recorded in the Bloodglass archives.
